decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the Flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">Notwithstanding the submitted details and
approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not shall not progress
beyond damp proof course level,&nbsp;until a Fire Safety Statement has been submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall
include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 30.15pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">1) identify suitably positioned
unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b)
appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 30.15pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">2) is designed to incorporate
appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious
injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and
passive and active fire safety measures <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 30.15pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">3) is constructed in an
appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 30.15pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">4) provide suitable and
convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building
users <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 30.15pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">5) develop a robust management
strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published
(details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published
to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 30.15pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">6) provide suitable access and
equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the
development.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The development shall be operated
in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p>



















</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none"><br></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The window(s) in the flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The
development hereby permitted shall be used for Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only
and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General
Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking or
re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no development within
Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><br></p>
<p>The roofspace of the proposed first floor flat shall not be used as additional accomodation space for the flat without the express consent of the local planning authority.</p>
description: Conversion of dwelling into two flats (1 X 3 bed and 1 X 2 bed) single storey front extension incorporating front porch; single and two storey side to rear extension; single storey rear extension; external alterations; separate amenity space; bin and cycle stores (demolition of garage)
